name: custom-ai-chat
title: Custom AI Chat
description: Chat with any OpenAI-compatible model using your own API key or local gateway, keeping each conversation and its context separate.
author: FTSzw

commands.name: ask-ai
commands.title: Ask AI
commands.description: Ask a question and continue it in its own conversation, with streaming answers from your own AI model or gateway.

preferences.name: configPath
preferences.title: Custom Configuration File
preferences.description: Optional. Select a providers.yaml file. Takes priority over the path below.

preferences.name: defaultConfigPath
preferences.title: Configuration File Path
preferences.description: Path to providers.yaml, used when no custom file is selected above.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
